  "type": "module",
  "packageManager": "pnpm@12.3.4",
  "devEngines": {
    "packageManager": {
      "name": "pnpm",
      "version": "12.3.4",
      "onFail": "ignore"
    }
  },
  "scripts": {
    "submodules": "node submodules.js",
    "postinstall": "husky install",
    "build": "pnpm run build:rust:wasm && node scripts/with-typescript-tooling-compat.mjs turbo run build --filter=\"./packages/*\"",
    "build:rust:native": "cargo xtask build-native --release",
    "build:rust:wasm": "cargo xtask build-wasm all",
    "build:site": "pnpm build && pnpm --filter site build",
    "build:site:cloudflare-pages": "pnpm build && pnpm --filter site build:cloudflare-pages",
    "build:examples": "node scripts/with-typescript-tooling-compat.mjs turbo run build --filter=\"./examples/*\"",
    "dev:site": "pnpm build && pnpm --filter site dev",
    "dev:site:clean": "pnpm --filter site clean:next && pnpm dev:site",
    "release:vscode": "node packages/vscode/scripts/release.js",
    "release": "semantic-release",
    "check": "pnpm run check:ai-context && pnpm run check:rust && pnpm run check:migration && pnpm run check:mdn-registry && pnpm run check:boundaries && pnpm run check:packages && pnpm run check:release && pnpm run commit-check && node scripts/with-typescript-tooling-compat.mjs turbo run test lint type-check --filter=\"./packages/*\" && pnpm run check:artifacts && pnpm run check:runtime-size",
    "check:ai-context": "node scripts/check-ai-context.mjs",
    "check:api-census": "node scripts/check-api-census.mjs",
    "check:artifacts": "node scripts/check-package-artifacts.mjs",
    "check:boundaries": "node scripts/check-rust-core-boundaries.mjs",
    "check:mdn-registry": "node scripts/build-rust-mdn-completion-registry.mjs --check",
    "check:migration": "node scripts/build-ts-test-migration-ledger.mjs --check",
    "check:packages": "node scripts/check-package-contracts.mjs",
    "check:packages:update": "node scripts/check-package-contracts.mjs --write",
    "check:runtime-size": "node scripts/check-runtime-bundle-size.mjs",
    "check:runtime-size:update": "node scripts/check-runtime-bundle-size.mjs --write",
    "check:rust": "cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && cargo xtask codegen --check && cargo xtask parity",
    "check:release": "node scripts/release-config-check.mjs",
    "test": "node scripts/with-typescript-tooling-compat.mjs turbo run test --filter=\"./packages/*\"",
    "test:ai-context": "node --test scripts/check-ai-context.test.mjs",
    "e2e": "node scripts/with-typescript-tooling-compat.mjs turbo run e2e --filter=\"./packages/*\" --filter=\"!@master/css-runtime\" --concurrency=1 && pnpm --filter @master/css-runtime e2e",
    "lint": "node scripts/with-typescript-tooling-compat.mjs turbo run lint --filter=\"./packages/*\"",
    "type-check": "node scripts/with-typescript-tooling-compat.mjs turbo run type-check --filter=\"./packages/*\"",
    "type-check:refs": "tsc -b tsconfig.typecheck.json",
    "type-check:clean": "tsc -b tsconfig.typecheck.json --clean",
    "type-check:affected": "turbo run type-check --affected",
    "commit-check": "commitlint --from=HEAD~1 --verbose"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": "^24"
  },
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "https://github.com/master-co/css.git"

    "@master/css": "workspace:^",

    "@master/css-svelte-addon": "workspace:^",
    "@master/css-tooling": "workspace:^",
    "@master/css-vite": "workspace:^",
    "@master/css-webpack": "workspace:^",
    "@master/eslint-config-css": "workspace:^"
  },
  "devDependencies": {

    "@aronrepo/conventional-changelog-config": "^2.2.1",
    "@aronrepo/conventional-commits": "^2.2.1",

    "@playwright/test": "1.63.0",

    "@types/node": "^24.13.3",
    "@types/node-fetch": "^2.6.13",

pnpm-workspace.yaml.content:
packages:
  - 'packages/*'
  - 'examples/*'
  - 'benchmarks'
  - 'internal'
  - 'site'

allowBuilds:
  '@aronrepo/*': true
  '@firebase/util': true
  '@parcel/watcher': true
  '@swc/core': true
  '@vscode/vsce-sign': true
  aronrepo: true
  esbuild: true
  keytar: true
  lmdb: true
  msgpackr-extract: true
  protobufjs: true
  sharp: true
  unrs-resolver: true
  workerd: true

minimumReleaseAgeExclude:
  - '@aronrepo/*'
  - aronrepo
  - '@typescript/typescript-aix-ppc64@7.0.2'
  - '@typescript/typescript-darwin-arm64@7.0.2'
  - '@typescript/typescript-darwin-x64@7.0.2'
  - '@typescript/typescript-freebsd-arm64@7.0.2'
  - '@typescript/typescript-freebsd-x64@7.0.2'
  - '@typescript/typescript-linux-arm64@7.0.2'
  - '@typescript/typescript-linux-arm@7.0.2'
  - '@typescript/typescript-linux-loong64@7.0.2'
  - '@typescript/typescript-linux-mips64el@7.0.2'
  - '@typescript/typescript-linux-ppc64@7.0.2'
  - '@typescript/typescript-linux-riscv64@7.0.2'
  - '@typescript/typescript-linux-s390x@7.0.2'
  - '@typescript/typescript-linux-x64@7.0.2'
  - '@typescript/typescript-netbsd-arm64@7.0.2'
  - '@typescript/typescript-netbsd-x64@7.0.2'
  - '@typescript/typescript-openbsd-arm64@7.0.2'
  - '@typescript/typescript-openbsd-x64@7.0.2'
  - '@typescript/typescript-sunos-x64@7.0.2'
  - '@typescript/typescript-win32-arm64@7.0.2'
  - '@typescript/typescript-win32-x64@7.0.2'
  - typescript@7.0.2
  - rolldown-plugin-dts@0.27.4
  - '@tanstack/history@1.162.2'
  - '@tanstack/react-router@1.170.33'
  - '@tanstack/react-start-client@1.168.31'
  - '@tanstack/react-start-rsc@0.1.49'
  - '@tanstack/react-start-server@1.167.38'
  - '@tanstack/react-start@1.168.50'
  - '@tanstack/router-core@1.171.28'
  - '@tanstack/router-generator@1.167.34'
  - '@tanstack/router-plugin@1.168.36'
  - '@tanstack/start-client-core@1.170.28'
  - '@tanstack/start-plugin-core@1.171.40'
  - '@tanstack/start-server-core@1.169.32'
  - '@tanstack/start-storage-context@1.167.30'

overrides:
  # Upstream pins currently retain vulnerable releases within these major lines.
  dompurify@>=3.0.0 <3.4.13: 3.4.13
  qs@>=6.0.0 <6.16.0: 6.16.0
  rolldown-plugin-dts: 0.27.4

supportedArchitectures:
  os:
    - win32
    - darwin
    - linux
  cpu:
    - x64
    - arm64
    - arm
  libc:
    - glibc
    - musl

verifyDepsBeforeRun: false

Cargo.toml.content:
[workspace]
resolver = "3"
members = [
  "crates/mastercss-schema",
  "crates/mastercss-lexer",
  "crates/mastercss-lint",
  "crates/mastercss-language",
  "crates/mastercss-cli",
  "crates/mastercss-engine",
  "crates/mastercss-compiler",
  "crates/mastercss-project",
  "crates/mastercss-diagnostics",
  "crates/mastercss-source",
  "crates/mastercss-scanner",
  "crates/mastercss-render",
  "crates/mastercss-validator",
  "crates/mastercss-binding-native",
  "crates/mastercss-binding-wasm-engine",
  "crates/mastercss-binding-wasm-compiler",
  "crates/mastercss-binding-wasm-tooling",
  "crates/xtask",
]

[workspace.package]
version = "0.0.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.97"
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/master-co/css"
publish = false

[workspace.dependencies]
cssparser = "0.37.0"
napi = { version = "3.12.2", default-features = false, features = ["napi8", "serde-json"] }
napi-build = "2.4.1"
napi-derive = "3.6.3"
htmlparser = "0.2.1"
# Must match lightningcss so the compiler Wasm binding enables its wasm_js backend.
getrandom = "0.3.4"
lightningcss = { version = "1.0.0-alpha.72", default-features = false, features = ["visitor"] }
oxc_allocator = "0.148.0"
oxc_ast = "0.148.0"
oxc_ast_visit = "0.148.0"
oxc_parser = { version = "0.148.0", default-features = false }
oxc_span = "0.148.0"
oxc_syntax = "0.148.0"
regex = "1.13.1"
serde = { version = "1.0.229", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = { version = "1.0.151", features = ["preserve_order"] }
sha2 = "0.11.0"
serde-wasm-bindgen = "0.6.5"
thiserror = "2.0.20"
wasm-bindgen = "0.2.128"
wasm-bindgen-cli-support = "0.2.128"

[profile.release]
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1
strip = "symbols"

[profile.release.package.mastercss-binding-wasm-engine]
opt-level = "s"

[profile.release.package.mastercss-binding-wasm-compiler]
opt-level = "s"

[profile.release.package.mastercss-binding-wasm-tooling]
opt-level = "s"
